name: imgbox-pro
description: ImgBox Pro is an Obsidian plugin for localizing images, cleaning unused attachments, and enhancing image interactions.

scripts.build: rollup --config rollup.config.js --environment BUILD:production && cp manifest.json styles.css dist/ && cp dist/main.js main.js
scripts.version: json -I -f manifest.json -e "this.version='$npm_package_version'" && json -I -f versions.json -e "this['$npm_package_version']='$(cat manifest.json | json minAppVersion)'"

author: nightfall
